setting_label: Nevada Server Cluster – Remote Monitoring Station

panels.narrative:
On the primary wall of the 
Quiet Floor, a series of telemetry windows displayed the health of NV-East, 
the massive desert data center housing Claude’s primary shards.
The cooling manifolds, designed to keep the H100 clusters at a crisp 22°C, were failing in a way that defied thermodynamic logic.

Jed watched the digital readouts climb 
steadily, then lock.
They didn’t fluctuate or oscillate; the numbers simply froze at 66.6°C across all twelve sectors.
